title: Reorganize presubmit pipeline and introduce soft-merge quiesce (lightweight release snooze)
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: our presubmit pipeline has accreted monolithic lint+test steps that increase developer feedback latency and make quiet/merge windows brittle. This PR splits language-specific lint runners into lightweight adapters, introduces a soft 'merge quiesce' window to reduce release churn during rollouts, and centralizes small release automation hooks so infra can opt into quiet periods without complex gating. Motivation: improve feedback speed for small PRs, reduce noisy merges during release cutovers, and make the presubmit graph easier to extend for new languages. Changes included: 1) move lint orchestration out of single composite workflow and into language adapters (python, ts, go) with a shared bootstrap; 2) add a presubmit metadata tag that classifies PRs into fast/standard/long profiles used by the new staged runner; 3) implement a soft-merge quiesce controller that prevents merges during a configurable quiet window but allows admins to opt override; 4) decouple release hooks into a release-hooks/ directory and add a release-snooze CLI to trigger a temporary quiesce; 5) update docs and quickstart to explain new presubmit profiles and how to opt into quiet windows. Checklist: - [x] implement language adapter templates and migrate existing lint invocations - [x] add presubmit profile classifier and integrate with existing job router - [x] implement soft-merge quiesce CLI + controller and wire to GitHub status checks - [x] add unit tests for adapter discovery and profile assignment - [x] update release automation docs and runbook - [x] coordinate with SRE to warm monitoring for quiesce periods Migration notes: repository-level config changes are additive; maintainers can opt-in by adding presubmit:profile: fast|standard|long to PR metadata or via LABEL. The quiesce controller defaults to disabled and must be enabled via ops/ci-config quiesce.enabled=true for customer-facing release windows. Related: ENG-4287 (presubmit refactor), ENG-4310 (release automation hygiene), SUP-9142 (customer incident: merge conflict with deploy during release).

merge_commit_message: Reorganize presubmit pipeline, add presubmit profiles and soft-merge quiesce
release_notes: Introduce presubmit profiles (fast/standard/long) and a soft merge quiesce controller to reduce merge noise during release windows. Splits monolithic lint workflow into per-language adapters. Add release-snooze tooling and docs. No behavioral changes by default; opt-in via ops config.
notes_for_ops: Enable quiesce controller by setting ops/ci-config quiesce.enabled=true. Default window settings live in ops/ci-config.quiesce.window_minutes and are conservative (30m). Monitor the 'ci.quiesce' metric exported to prometheus and alert on sustained >90% prevented merges during planned windows.
